<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover">
<meta name="color-scheme" content="dark">
<title>S&amp;P 500 roulette table: which numbers hit</title>
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter:wght@400;500;600;700&family=JetBrains+Mono:wght@400;500&family=Playfair+Display:wght@700;800&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
:root{
  color-scheme:dark;
  --bg0:#02100a;--bg1:#0d4a30;--ink:#efe9d6;--ink2:#cbc3a6;--muted:#8fa89a;
  --gold:#e0b85a;--gold-hi:#f6dc92;--copper:#c47a47;--blue:#8fd3ff;
  --serif:'Playfair Display',Georgia,'Times New Roman',serif;
  --line:rgba(224,200,140,.2);--panel:rgba(3,18,12,.94);
  --mono:'JetBrains Mono',ui-monospace,SFMono-Regular,Menlo,Consolas,monospace;
  --sans:'Inter',system-ui,-apple-system,'Segoe UI',Roboto,sans-serif;
  box-sizing:border-box;
  padding-top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px);
  padding-bottom:env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px);
}
*,*::before,*::after{box-sizing:inherit}
html{height:100%;scroll-padding-top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px);background:var(--bg0)}
body{height:100%;margin:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;overflow:hidden;font-family:var(--sans);color:var(--ink);
  background:radial-gradient(120% 70% at 50% 42%,var(--bg1) 0%,#062a1b 45%,var(--bg0) 100%);-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased}
button{font-family:inherit}
:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--gold);outline-offset:2px}

.stage{position:relative;flex:1 1 auto;min-height:0;overflow:hidden}
#gl{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;display:block;touch-action:none;cursor:grab}
#gl:active{cursor:grabbing}
.head{position:absolute;inset:0 0 auto 0;padding:14px 18px 0;text-align:center;pointer-events:none;z-index:2;
  background:linear-gradient(to bottom,rgba(2,16,10,.88) 0%,rgba(2,16,10,.55) 70%,rgba(2,16,10,0) 100%);padding-bottom:12px}
.head{text-shadow:0 1px 10px rgba(2,16,10,.95),0 0 3px rgba(2,16,10,.8)}
.eyebrow{font:500 11px/1 var(--mono);letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted)}
h1{margin:10px auto 0;max-width:24ch;font:800 clamp(22px,6vw,38px)/1.1 var(--serif);letter-spacing:0;color:var(--ink);text-wrap:balance}
.meta{margin-top:10px;font:400 12px var(--mono);color:var(--muted)}
.meta b{color:var(--ink);font-weight:500;margin:0 .7em 0 .3em}
.demo{display:inline-block;margin-top:8px;padding:4px 10px;border:1px solid rgba(196,122,71,.55);border-radius:99px;font:500 11px var(--mono);color:#e5a06f;background:rgba(196,122,71,.08)}
.demo[hidden]{display:none}
.scenelabel{margin-top:8px;text-align:left;font:500 11px var(--mono);letter-spacing:.08em;color:var(--ink2);text-transform:uppercase}

.foot{position:absolute;left:0;right:0;bottom:0;padding:34px 0 10px;text-align:center;pointer-events:none;z-index:2;background:linear-gradient(to top,rgba(2,16,10,.9) 0%,rgba(2,16,10,.6) 55%,rgba(2,16,10,0) 100%)}
.date{font:500 clamp(15px,4.2vw,20px) var(--mono);letter-spacing:.1em;color:#d9cc96;text-transform:uppercase}
.daystat{margin-top:6px;font:400 12px var(--mono);color:var(--muted)}
.up{color:#f0c85a}.down{color:#ff6b5e}.beat{color:#5fe07a}
.legend{display:flex;gap:12px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:6px;text-align:left;font:400 11px var(--mono);color:var(--ink2)}
.legend i{display:inline-block;width:9px;height:9px;border-radius:50%;margin-right:5px;vertical-align:0}
.legend .g{background:#4fdc6b}.legend .y{background:#f0c85a}.legend .r{background:#ef4b3f}
.hint{display:none;margin-top:6px;font:400 11px var(--mono);color:#6e8a7b;transition:opacity .4s}
.tip{position:absolute;z-index:4;pointer-events:none;padding:7px 10px;border-radius:8px;background:rgba(3,18,12,.95);border:1px solid var(--line);
  font:400 12px/1.4 var(--mono);color:var(--ink);transform:translate(-50%,-115%);white-space:nowrap;display:none}
.tip b{font-weight:500;color:var(--gold-hi)}
.toast{position:absolute;z-index:6;left:50%;bottom:76px;transform:translateX(-50%);padding:8px 14px;border-radius:99px;background:rgba(6,30,20,.96);border:1px solid var(--line);font:400 12px var(--mono);color:var(--ink);display:none;max-width:90%;text-align:center}
.toast.err{border-color:rgba(196,122,71,.7);color:#f0b48a}
#nogl{position:absolute;inset:0;display:grid;place-items:center;z-index:3;padding:30px;text-align:center;color:var(--ink2);font:400 14px var(--sans)}
#nogl[hidden]{display:none}

.sheet{flex:0 0 auto;background:var(--panel);border-top:1px solid var(--line);backdrop-filter:blur(10px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(10px);z-index:5;position:relative}
.transport{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding:10px 14px 6px}
#play{flex:none;width:40px;height:40px;border-radius:50%;border:1px solid rgba(226,189,95,.6);background:rgba(226,189,95,.12);color:var(--gold);display:grid;place-items:center;cursor:pointer}
#play svg{width:16px;height:16px;fill:currentColor}
#speed{flex:none;min-width:44px;height:30px;border-radius:99px;border:1px solid var(--line);background:rgba(224,200,140,.06);color:var(--ink2);font:500 12px var(--mono);cursor:pointer}
input[type=range]{-webkit-appearance:none;appearance:none;width:100%;height:28px;background:transparent;margin:0;min-width:0}
input[type=range]::-webkit-slider-runnable-track{height:4px;border-radius:2px;background:rgba(224,200,140,.26)}
input[type=range]::-webkit-slider-thumb{-webkit-appearance:none;width:20px;height:20px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--gold);margin-top:-8px;border:2px solid #1a1405}
input[type=range]::-moz-range-track{height:4px;border-radius:2px;background:rgba(224,200,140,.26)}
input[type=range]::-moz-range-thumb{width:16px;height:16px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--gold);border:2px solid #1a1405}
input[type=range]:disabled{opacity:.35}
.tabs{display:flex;border-top:1px solid var(--line)}
.tabs button{flex:1;padding:11px 4px;background:none;border:0;border-bottom:2px solid transparent;color:var(--muted);font:500 13px var(--sans);cursor:pointer}
.tabs button[aria-selected=true]{color:var(--gold-hi)}
.sheet[data-open="1"] .tabs button[aria-selected=true]{border-bottom-color:var(--gold)}
.panes{max-height:0;overflow:hidden;transition:max-height .25s ease}
.sheet[data-open="1"] .panes{max-height:38vh;overflow:auto}
.pane{display:none;padding:12px 16px 18px}
.pane[data-active]{display:block}
.row{display:flex;gap:10px}
label.f{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:5px;flex:1;min-width:0;font:500 11px var(--mono);color:var(--muted);letter-spacing:.06em}
input[type=date],input[type=password],input[type=number],input[type=text]{width:100%;background:rgba(224,200,140,.08);border:1px solid var(--line);color:var(--ink);border-radius:8px;padding:9px 10px;font:400 14px var(--mono);color-scheme:dark;min-width:0}
.sec{margin:16px 0 0;font:600 12px var(--sans);color:var(--ink2)}
.chips{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:7px;margin-top:9px}
.chip{padding:7px 11px;border-radius:99px;border:1px solid var(--line);background:rgba(224,200,140,.06);color:var(--ink);font:500 12.5px var(--sans);cursor:pointer}
.chip[aria-pressed=true]{border-color:rgba(226,189,95,.7);color:var(--gold-hi);background:rgba(226,189,95,.12)}
.chip.primary{border-color:rgba(226,189,95,.7);color:var(--gold-hi);background:rgba(226,189,95,.14)}
.chip[hidden]{display:none}
.seg{display:flex;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:10px;overflow:hidden}
.seg button{flex:1;padding:9px 6px;background:none;border:0;color:var(--ink2);font:500 13px var(--sans);cursor:pointer}
.seg button[aria-pressed=true]{background:rgba(226,189,95,.14);color:var(--gold-hi)}
.slider{display:block;margin-top:14px;font:500 13px var(--sans);color:var(--ink2)}
.slider .t{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:baseline}
.slider output{font:500 13px var(--mono);color:var(--gold-hi)}
.checks{display:flex;gap:18px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:14px;font:500 13px var(--sans);color:var(--ink2)}
.checks label{display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:center;cursor:pointer}
.checks input{accent-color:#e2bd5f;width:16px;height:16px}
.kpis{display:grid;gap:7px 14px;align-items:baseline;margin:8px 0 6px}
.kpis .l{color:var(--ink2);font-size:13px}
.kpis .v{font:500 15px var(--mono);text-align:right}
.kpis .p{color:var(--blue)}
.kpis .hd{font:500 11px var(--mono);color:var(--muted);text-align:right}
.winlabel{font:500 12px var(--mono);color:var(--muted)}
.insight{margin:10px 0 8px;font:400 13px/1.5 var(--sans);color:var(--ink2);max-width:60ch}
#curve{width:100%;height:160px;display:block;margin-top:4px}
.cap{margin:6px 0 0;font:400 11.5px/1.5 var(--sans);color:var(--muted);max-width:60ch}
.note{margin:14px 0 0;font:400 11.5px/1.5 var(--sans);color:var(--muted);max-width:60ch}
.btnrow{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:12px}
.info{font:400 13px/1.5 var(--sans);color:var(--ink2)}
.info.err{color:#f0b48a}
.slider[hidden]{display:none}
.board{margin-top:6px;font:400 11px var(--mono);color:var(--ink2);display:grid;gap:3px}
.board b{display:inline-block;min-width:34px;padding:1px 6px;border-radius:99px;font-weight:600;margin-right:5px;font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.06em}
.board .hotb{background:#e0b85a;color:#1a1405}.board .coldb{background:#8fd3ff;color:#06202e}
.wheelbox{display:flex;gap:14px;align-items:center;margin:4px 0 12px}
#wheel{width:min(52vw,230px);height:min(52vw,230px);flex:none}
.wheelside{min-width:0}.wheelside .cap{margin-top:8px}
.rtag{position:absolute;z-index:3;pointer-events:none;font:500 11px var(--mono);color:#e6e9fb;background:rgba(3,18,12,.86);border:1px solid var(--rc,#7fd4ff);padding:3px 8px;border-radius:99px;white-space:nowrap}
.rtag[hidden]{display:none}
.betag{position:absolute;z-index:3;pointer-events:none;font:500 11px var(--mono);color:#f6dc92;background:rgba(3,18,12,.85);border:1px solid rgba(224,184,90,.85);padding:3px 9px;border-radius:99px;white-space:nowrap}
.betag[hidden]{display:none}
.tl{width:18px;height:18px;border-radius:4px;vertical-align:-4px;margin-right:6px;background:#f3f5ff;object-fit:contain}
#gDistWrap[hidden]{display:none}
.seg button:disabled{opacity:.35;cursor:not-allowed}
.rows{display:flex;flex-direction:column;margin-top:8px}
.lrow{display:grid;grid-template-columns:20px minmax(0,1fr) auto 88px;gap:8px;align-items:center;padding:9px 2px;background:none;border:0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);color:var(--ink);text-align:left;cursor:pointer;font:400 13px var(--sans);width:100%}
.lrow .rk{font:400 11px var(--mono);color:var(--muted)}
.lrow .nm{min-width:0;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap}
.lrow .nm b{font:500 13px var(--mono);color:var(--ink);margin-right:7px}
.lrow .nm small{color:var(--muted);font-size:11.5px}
.lrow .v{font:500 13px var(--mono);text-align:right}
.lrow .v2{font:400 11px var(--mono);color:var(--muted);text-align:right}
.bars{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) 84px 42px;gap:7px 10px;align-items:center;margin-top:8px;font:400 12.5px var(--sans);color:var(--ink2)}
.bars .n{overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap}
.bars .bar{height:8px;border-radius:4px;background:rgba(224,200,140,.12);overflow:hidden}
.bars .bar i{display:block;height:100%;background:var(--gold)}
.bars .bar i.neg{background:var(--copper)}
.bars .p{font:500 12px var(--mono);text-align:right;color:var(--ink)}
#gChart{width:100%;height:170px;display:block;margin-top:6px}
.lg{display:flex;gap:6px 14px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:6px;font:400 11.5px var(--mono);color:var(--ink2)}
.lg i{display:inline-block;width:14px;height:3px;border-radius:2px;margin-right:6px;vertical-align:middle}
.sec+.f,.f+.checks{margin-top:10px}
.info b{color:var(--ink);font-weight:500}

.modal{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:20;display:none;background:rgba(2,5,16,.82);padding:max(16px,env(safe-area-inset-top)) 14px max(16px,env(safe-area-inset-bottom));overflow:auto}
.modal.on{display:block}
.card{max-width:660px;margin:0 auto;background:#08241a;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:14px;padding:18px}
.card h2{margin:0 0 10px;font:700 20px var(--sans);letter-spacing:-.01em}
.card ol{margin:0 0 12px;padding-left:20px;font:400 13.5px/1.6 var(--sans);color:var(--ink2)}
pre{margin:0;background:#041a12;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:10px;padding:12px;overflow:auto;max-height:44vh;font:400 11.5px/1.5 var(--mono);color:#c5cbe8;white-space:pre}

body.open .eyebrow,body.open h1,body.open .hint{display:none}
body.open .meta{margin-top:0}
@media (min-width:900px){
  body{flex-direction:row}
  .stage{order:1}
  .sheet{order:2;width:380px;height:100%;border-top:0;border-left:1px solid var(--line);display:flex;flex-direction:column}
  .panes,.sheet[data-open="1"] .panes{max-height:none;flex:1;min-height:0;overflow:auto}
  .sheet[data-open="0"] .tabs button[aria-selected=true]{border-bottom-color:var(--gold)}
}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.panes{transition:none}}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<main class="stage" id="stage">
  <canvas id="gl" aria-label="3D stacks of coins, one per S&amp;P 500 stock"></canvas>
  <div id="nogl" hidden>WebGL isn't available in this browser, so the 3D view can't draw. Try Safari, Chrome or Firefox with hardware acceleration on.</div>
  <header class="head">
    <div class="eyebrow">Place your bets</div>
    <h1>$100 on every number. See which ones hit.</h1>
    <div class="meta" id="meta"></div>
    <div class="demo" id="demoPill" hidden>Simulated demo data. Real prices: Data tab.</div>
    <div class="scenelabel" id="sceneLabel"></div>
    <div class="legend"><span><i class="g"></i>Hit</span><span><i class="y"></i>Small win</span><span><i class="r"></i>Bust</span><span style="opacity:.7">vs the market</span></div>
  </header>
  <div class="tip" id="tip"></div>
  <div class="betag" id="beTag" hidden>$100 bet · break-even</div>
  <div id="refTags"></div>
  <div class="toast" id="toast"></div>
  <div class="foot">
    <div class="date" id="date"></div>
    <div class="daystat" id="daystat"></div>
    <div class="board"><div><b class="hotb">HOT</b><span id="hotList"></span></div><div><b class="coldb">COLD</b><span id="coldList"></span></div></div>
    <div class="hint" id="hint">Drag to orbit · pinch to zoom · tap a stack</div>
  </div>
</main>

<section class="sheet" id="sheet" data-open="0">
  <div class="transport">
    <button id="play" aria-label="Play"><svg viewBox="0 0 16 16" id="playIcon"><path d="M3 1.5v13l11-6.5z"/></svg></button>
    <input id="scrub" type="range" min="0" max="0" step="1" value="0" aria-label="Day in selected period">
    <button id="speed" aria-label="Playback speed">1×</button>
  </div>
  <nav class="tabs" role="tablist">
    <button role="tab" data-tab="period" aria-selected="false">Period</button>
    <button role="tab" data-tab="view" aria-selected="false">View</button>
    <button role="tab" data-tab="gains" aria-selected="false">Numbers</button>
    <button role="tab" data-tab="stats" aria-selected="false">Correlation</button>
    <button role="tab" data-tab="data" aria-selected="false">Data</button>
  </nav>
  <div class="panes">
    <div class="pane" data-pane="period">
      <div class="row">
        <label class="f">From<input type="date" id="from"></label>
        <label class="f">To<input type="date" id="to"></label>
      </div>
      <div class="sec">Quick ranges</div>
      <div class="chips" id="ranges"></div>
      <div class="sec">Market episodes</div>
      <div class="chips" id="events"></div>
    </div>

    <div class="pane" data-pane="view">
      <div class="seg" id="modeSeg">
        <button data-mode="cum" aria-pressed="true">Gains since start</button>
        <button data-mode="daily" aria-pressed="false">Daily move</button>
      </div>
      <div class="sec">Camera</div>
      <div class="seg" id="camSeg"><button data-cam="angled" aria-pressed="true">Angled</button><button data-cam="top" aria-pressed="false">Top-down</button></div>
      <div class="sec">Stacks show</div>
      <div class="seg" id="metricSeg">
        <button data-metric="price" aria-pressed="true">Price move</button>
        <button data-metric="contrib" aria-pressed="false">Index contribution</button>
      </div>
      <div class="sec">Height scale</div>
      <div class="seg" id="scaleSeg">
        <button data-scale="linear" aria-pressed="true">Linear</button>
        <button data-scale="log" aria-pressed="false">Log (lifts the middle)</button>
      </div>
      <div class="sec">Compare with</div>
      <div class="seg" id="refSeg">
        <button data-ref="off" aria-pressed="true">Nothing</button>
        <button data-ref="healthy" aria-pressed="false">Healthy market</button>
        <button data-ref="typical" aria-pressed="false">Typical market</button>
      </div>
      <p class="cap" id="refCap"></p>
      <div class="sec">Arrange stacks</div>
      <div class="seg" id="layoutSeg">
        <button data-layout="rank" aria-pressed="true">Hot to cold</button>
        <button data-layout="cap" aria-pressed="false">Table order</button>
        <button data-layout="sector" aria-pressed="false">By sector</button>
      </div>
      <label class="slider" id="multWrap"><span class="t">Exaggeration <output id="multOut">16×</output></span>
        <input type="range" id="mult" min="1" max="40" step="1" value="16"></label>
      <label class="slider"><span class="t">Basket size <output id="subOut"></output></span>
        <input type="range" id="subN" min="1" max="500" step="1" value="500"></label>
      <div class="btnrow"><button class="chip" id="reshuffle">Pick a different random basket</button></div>
      <div class="checks">
        <label><input type="checkbox" id="plane" checked>$100 line</label>
        <label><input type="checkbox" id="lossOn" checked>Red loss blocks</label>
        <label><input type="checkbox" id="idxBar" checked>S&amp;P bar</label>
        <label><input type="checkbox" id="idxLine" checked>S&amp;P line</label>
        <label><input type="checkbox" id="spin">Auto-rotate</label>
      </div>
      <label class="slider" id="logoWrap" hidden><span class="t">Logos above the tallest stacks <output id="logoOut">12</output></span>
        <input type="range" id="logoN" min="0" max="40" step="1" value="12"></label>
    </div>

    <div class="pane" data-pane="gains">
      <div class="winlabel" id="gWin"></div>
      <div class="wheelbox"><canvas id="wheel"></canvas>
        <div class="wheelside"><button class="chip primary" id="wheelSpin">Spin the wheel</button>
          <p class="cap" id="wheelRes">The 36 hottest numbers, plus 0 (the S&amp;P) and 00 (the median stock). Where does the ball land?</p></div></div>
      <div class="kpis" id="gKpis" style="grid-template-columns:1fr auto"></div>
      <canvas id="gChart"></canvas>
      <div class="lg" id="gLegend"></div>
      <p class="insight" id="gInsight"></p>
      <div id="gDistWrap" hidden>
        <div class="sec">How distorted is this?</div>
        <div class="kpis" id="gDist" style="grid-template-columns:1fr auto auto"></div>
        <p class="cap" id="gDistNote"></p>
      </div>
      <div class="seg" id="rankSeg">
        <button data-rank="ret" aria-pressed="true">Hot</button>
        <button data-rank="cold" aria-pressed="false">Cold</button>
        <button data-rank="imp" aria-pressed="false">Index impact</button>
      </div>
      <div class="rows" id="gList"></div>
      <div class="sec" id="gSectTitle"></div>
      <div class="bars" id="gSect"></div>
      <p class="note" id="gNote"></p>
    </div>

    <div class="pane" data-pane="stats">
      <div class="winlabel" id="winLabel"></div>
      <div class="kpis" id="kpis"></div>
      <p class="insight" id="insight"></p>
      <canvas id="curve"></canvas>
      <p class="cap">Swing of an equal-weight basket (annualised volatility) as stocks are added. Where the line flattens, the remaining swing is what every stock shares.</p>
      <div class="btnrow">
        <button class="chip" id="pin">Pin this period to compare</button>
        <button class="chip" id="unpin" hidden>Clear pin</button>
      </div>
      <p class="cap" id="pinCap"></p>
    </div>

    <div class="pane" data-pane="data">
      <p class="info" id="dataInfo"></p>
      <p class="info" id="capInfo" style="margin-top:6px"></p>
      <p class="info" id="logoInfo" style="margin-top:6px"></p>
      <p class="info" id="benchInfo" style="margin-top:6px"></p>
      <div class="btnrow" id="benchRow" hidden><button class="chip" data-bk="^GSPC">S&amp;P index (price, like Yahoo)</button><button class="chip" data-bk="SPY">SPY (dividends included)</button></div>
      <div class="btnrow">
        <button class="chip primary" id="loadBtn">Load price file</button>
        <button class="chip" id="howBtn">Get real data</button>
        <button class="chip" id="capBtn">Load market caps</button>
        <button class="chip" id="logoBtn">Load logos</button>
        <button class="chip" id="benchBtn">Load S&amp;P 500 file</button>

<script type="text/plain" id="pyscript">"""Download S&P 500 prices from Yahoo Finance for the coin-stack page.

Setup:  pip install yfinance pandas lxml requests
Run:    python download_sp500.py        (writes sp500_prices.json)
Colab:  paste into a cell, run, then download sp500_prices.json from the file panel.
"""
import io
import json

import pandas as pd
import requests
import yfinance as yf

START = "2017-01-01"  # earliest date to fetch; use "2010-01-01" for longer history
URL = "https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_S%26P_500_companies"

html = requests.get(URL, headers={"User-Agent": "Mozilla/5.0"}, timeout=30).text
tbl = pd.read_html(io.StringIO(html))[0]
sector_col = next(c for c in tbl.columns if "Sector" in str(c))
tbl["Yahoo"] = tbl["Symbol"].astype(str).str.replace(".", "-", regex=False)
tbl = tbl.drop_duplicates("Yahoo").set_index("Yahoo")
symbols = tbl.index.tolist()
print(f"{len(symbols)} symbols, downloading from {START} ...")

parts = []
for i in range(0, len(symbols), 100):
    chunk = symbols[i:i + 100]
    try:
        df = yf.download(chunk, start=START, auto_adjust=True,
                         progress=False, threads=True)["Close"]
        parts.append(df)
    except Exception as err:
        print("  skipped a batch:", err)
    print(f"  {min(i + 100, len(symbols))}/{len(symbols)}")

px = pd.concat(parts, axis=1).sort_index().dropna(how="all")
px = px.loc[:, px.notna().sum() > 60]

# While the market is open Yahoo returns a partial, intraday row for today.
# Drop it so every number in the page is based on a final closing price.
now = pd.Timestamp.now(tz="America/New_York")
if len(px) and px.index[-1].date() == now.date() and now.weekday() < 5 and (now.hour, now.minute) < (16, 10):
    print(f"Dropped {px.index[-1].date()}: the market hasn't closed, so that row is a partial day. "
          "Run this again after 4:10 pm ET to include it.")
    px = px.iloc[:-1]

out = {
    "dates": [d.strftime("%Y-%m-%d") for d in px.index],
    "tickers": list(px.columns),
    "names": [str(tbl.loc[c, "Security"]) for c in px.columns],
    "sectors": [str(tbl.loc[c, sector_col]) for c in px.columns],
    "prices": [[None if pd.isna(v) else round(float(v), 3) for v in px[c]]
               for c in px.columns],
}
with open("sp500_prices.json", "w") as f:
    json.dump(out, f, separators=(",", ":"))
print(f"Saved sp500_prices.json: {len(out['tickers'])} stocks, {len(out['dates'])} days")
</script>
<script type="application/json" id="embedded">
